seoTitle: Base64 to File: Decode and Download Any Type
metaDescription: Decode Base64, Base64URL or a data: URI and download the bytes as a file, with the type detected from the content. Runs in your browser.
intro: Decodes Base64 and saves the bytes as a file with the right extension.
why:
You may get an attachment, an image or an archive as a Base64 string from an API, an email source or a log. The text has to become a file before anything can open it.

The tool accepts standard and URL-safe Base64 and data: URIs, tolerates missing padding and line breaks, and looks at the first bytes to pick the type and extension for PNG, JPEG, PDF, ZIP and more. A declared type that disagrees with the bytes is flagged.
howTo: Paste the Base64 string or data URI.
Set a file name if you like.

faq.a: The string may be cut off or double encoded. Check the first bytes shown.

faq.q: Why was an extension chosen for me?
faq.a: It follows the detected content, not the name.
The PDF tool also checks the header and ending.
